title: The Faceted Mind Discipline
summary: The school discipline of a mind cut in many clear facets so no blow or trick finds it unready and ending in the school's faceted stand.

title: Canon of the Perfect Lattice
summary: The school canon of a lattice set so perfectly through the field that it bears any load and closes in the school's lattice of ruin.

title: The Crown of a Thousand Facets
summary: The school's high course of a thousand facets cut from the formed core that scatter and return light and force in a single crown.

title: The Cut Glass Discipline
summary: The school discipline of glass-clear crystal cut on the wind that slashes and screens and ends in the school's fall of cutting glass.

title: Canon of the Brilliant Edge
summary: The school canon of an edge so bright and keen that it parts a guard before the eye can follow it.

title: The Deep Geode Crown
summary: The school's deepest course in a hollowed geode grown from the formed core that blooms with crystal and mends the allies in it.
